top_signals.title: Yen Holds Gains Against Dollar After BOJ Keeps Rates Steady
top_signals.summary: The yen held gains against the dollar after the Bank of Japan kept interest rates unchanged as expected and indicated that the price trend reaches 2% for the first time.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Further support for Ukraine
top_signals.summary: The Chancellor has announced a new package of over £10bn in economic and military support for Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOJ holds rates as inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
top_signals.summary: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Uproar in Alaska sparks Democratic fears for Senate majority
top_signals.summary: Campaign mishaps and infighting could undermine party’s push to take Republican strongholds
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. fires senior army general over alleged leaks: reports
top_signals.summary: Since returning to office early last year, Trump has overseen a purge of top military personnel, including the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

top_signals.summary: Partners were stunned by the realisation that a profitable 95-year-old firm with 1,200 lawyers could be felled by a string of departures
